terra.problem: The line calls Marah “a bitter water,” but Marah was a place where the water was bitter.

The line says the LORD made the water “sweet and healed,” suggesting a healing occurred. The verses say the water was sweetened and that the LORD is the one who heals Israel, but do not report a healing at Marah.
“Three days in the desert with no water” goes beyond Exodus 15:22, which says they walked three days without finding water. It does not say they had no water at all.
